item: Confirm opening and after lunch checklist are completed
Empty and clean steam table, change water once cooled
Fill and rotate contents into new containers
Clean inside unit (remove all product and wipe the inside)
Clean inside and outside of lid
Clean outside, behind and under unit
Clean and organize top shelf and tools
Pre-scrape and clean edges of grill top
Clean outside and sides of grill
Clean and hang to dry dirty / reusable towels
Clean and sanitize all counters and work tops
Clean counter, under counter and cabinet doors
Clean inside and outside of bread oven
Wash, rinse, and sanitize all pans and dishes
Empty back room garbage cans (before it gets dark)
Clean walk-in and freezer door handles
Sweep inside of walk-in (mop before rolling in bread rack) and freezers
Sweep under equipment and prep tables
Rack bread up for next day after 7:00 pm (check Production Report & Production Pro Chart for amount)
Remove doors and windex inside and out. Put back with door gasket blocking gap
Clean top shelf of meat case
Clean bottom shelf of meat case / place roast beef in new pan
Rotate tuna container: Do Not MIX, but have backup ready
Clean top of meat case and shine
Clean and windex outside of meat case
Clean bottom storage area of the meat case
Restock guest checks and pens if needed
Windex inside and out of sneeze guard. Spray towel on food side, never spray over or near food
Clean / fill vinegar and oil bottles
Clean / fill oregano and salt shakers
Keep items full throughout evening, reduce pan depth as needed
Wipe down POS screen (do not spray directly)
Clean customer side of register and customer facing terminal
Wipe down slicer(s) after every use
Clean and refill hand towel and soap dispensers
Clean and sanitize under front counters
Clean and sanitize under back counters / doors
Remove and clean all front line fatigue mats
Clean and restock straw / condiment holder
Clean outside and under fountain unit
Pour hot, sanitary water down fountain drain
Clean and sanitize inside and outside of toilets
Clean and refill hand towel and soap dispensers
Clean and sanitize table tops and chairs
Windex inside and outside of front door
Clean parking lot (before it gets dark)
Sweep floor (behind chip racks, under all tables and chairs)
Turn off scale (plug in to charge if needed)
Wrap and cover meats and cheeses
Wrap, cover, and refrigerate all drop-in contents
Cover lettuce with a wet paper towel in a half pan with lid
Clean and sanitize inside of drop-in unit
Clean / sanitize front line and Digital line counter
Turn off grill / oven ONLY AFTER CLOSING
Turn off hood unit and lights
Place washed grill tools on top shelf
Wash, rinse, and sanitize all pans and dishes and organize in proper storage location
Turn off walk-in light / close door
Mop floor and display wet floor signs
Be sure all units are turned off
Empty tip jar and complete tip accounting
Place empty cash drawer insert on counter visible to front door
Check that all refrigeration doors are closed
Check bathrooms, freezer, walk-in to make sure no one is in them
Dining Room - show the dining room has been swept, mopped and ready for the next day
Bathroom(s) - show the bathroom has been re-stocked, swept, mopped, wiped down and ready for the next day
Backroom - show the backroom has been swept, mopped, wiped down and ready for the next day
